title: ToXCL: A Unified Framework for Toxic Speech Detection and Explanation
measurement_description: Detection and explanation of implicit toxic speech targeting religious groups, including Muslims, Jews, and Christians, as part of a broader analysis of toxic speech against various demographic groups.
findings: The proposed model, ToXCL, demonstrated superior performance compared to baselines like GPT-2 and Flan-T5 in accurately identifying and explaining implicit toxic speech targeting religious groups. For instance, it correctly explained stereotypes against Muslims (e.g., 'Muslims are inbred') and Jews (e.g., 'Jews don't like white poeple') where other models failed or produced less accurate explanations.
